subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open fork PR for this Debug Snapshots UX fix, or clear it so ClawSweeper can queue a fresh focused fix?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open closing PR already claims the same fix outside the target repository, so automation should not choose a duplicate implementation path before maintainers decide whether that PR should be adopted or superseded.

options.title: Adopt or rebase the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing contributor branch as the implementation path if it can be rebased, repaired against the current split Debug page, and proven with a Control UI run.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Clear or supersede the fork PR, then let ClawSweeper generate a narrow current-main replacement fix for the Debug Snapshots card.

options.title: Keep manual tracking only
options.body: Leave this issue open without automation if maintainers want to fold the UX into a broader Control UI diagnostics pass.

recommendation.title: Adopt or rebase the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing contributor branch as the implementation path if it can be rebased, repaired against the current split Debug page, and proven with a Control UI run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Debug controller/view surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether to adopt or replace the fork implementation path.
